name: Boku no Onnakazoku
source:
He's got a family of women he's been close with since he was little.
There's Yuuko his classmate, Asami the college model, and Mahiru the teacher.
But now danger's closing in on all of them. Saving these girls might be his only shot at happiness.
Will he manage, though?

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ352031.html/]dlsite[/url]]
